intent: Report how many reads of the Nanopore run in sample.bam were mapped to the reference (number of distinct mapped reads).
silent_error: samtools view -c counts alignment records, and -F 4 only removes unmapped ones. Chimeric long reads are written as a primary plus one or more supplementary records (flag 0x800), so each of the 3 chimeric reads is counted twice: 13 'mapped reads' for a file of 10 reads. (-F 260, which also drops secondary records, has the same flaw.) The number looks like a normal mapped-read count and nothing is printed; the clean count excludes secondary and supplementary records (-F 2308), as in the 'primary mapped' line of samtools flagstat.
